description: interpolation by 3 with a low-pass on real samples vs interp_fir_filter_fff

fixed_vs_float.rationale: Taps rounded to Q15 (sum of |tap rounding error| 2.0747825028876246e-4) acting on an input peak of 0.705 FS per component, plus 0.5 LSB of output rounding (Q15) and 0.02 Q15 LSB for the f32 reference itself; per component <= 5.313046350350828 Q15 LSB. SNR minimum is the measured value minus 1 dB.

Taps rounded to Q15 (sum of |tap rounding error| 2.0747825028876246e-4) acting on an input peak of 0.705 FS per component, plus 1.0 LSB of output rounding (Q15) and 0.02 Q15 LSB for the f32 reference itself; per component <= 5.813046350350828 Q15 LSB. SNR minimum is the measured value minus 1 dB.

Taps rounded to Q17 (sum of |tap rounding error| 4.779299111888364e-5) acting on an input peak of 0.705 FS per component, plus 0.5 LSB of output rounding (Q17) and 0.02 Q15 LSB for the f32 reference itself; per component <= 1.2490869167534233 Q15 LSB. SNR minimum is the measured value minus 1 dB.

float_vs_gnuradio.rationale: f32 rounding in an 29-tap sum: each of the n additions errs by at most 2^-24 of the partial sum (<= peak * sum|taps| = 3.0791034462288467); twice that covers both evaluation orders (GNU Radio uses SIMD kernels): 0.3488 Q15 LSB. SNR minimum is the measured value minus 1 dB.
